items.title: Iran deal presents political nightmare for Netanyahu
items.description: Donald Trump's ceasefire agreement with Iran leaves the Israeli PM trapped in a new political and security dilemma.

items.title: Russian artist and Putin critic shot dead in Poland
items.description: Robert Kuzovkov, who used the pseudonym Semyon Skrepetsky, has been known for his caricatures of politicians including Vladimir Putin.

items.title: Eight dead after US Air Force B-52 bomber crashes in California
items.description: The incident occurred on Monday morning while the aircraft had been on a routine test mission.

items.title: California's Gavin Newsom alleges justice department is investigating his wife and ex-staff
items.description: A source familiar with the investigations says they had been ongoing for "roughly a year".

items.title: 'Dancing girl's' bare torso restored in Indian textbook after backlash
items.description: A picture in a new school textbook had covered up the naked torso of the famous figurine with dark shading.

items.title: Cuba tourism collapses as US pressure campaign bites
items.description: The number of foreign visitors is down by 58% compared to last year, Cuban officials say, amid sanctions and an effective oil blockade.

items.title: Japan raises interest rate to highest for 31 years
items.description: The Bank of Japan has been raising rates from near-zero since 2024.

items.title: India temporarily bans Telegram over exam paper leak concerns
items.description: The NEET exam had earlier been scrapped over allegations of a paper leak, sparking massive protests.

items.title: Tunisia sack head coach just one game into World Cup
items.description: Tunisia sack Sabri Lamouchi one game into their World Cup, with former Morocco and Saudi Arabia manager Herve Renard replacing him.

items.title: Married at First Sight Australia allegations 'disturbing', says country's watchdog
items.description: The claims also prompted a response from UK media regulator Ofcom, who called them "deeply concerning".

items.title: Nigerian army frees widow of ex-general who died in captivity
items.description: Maj Gen Rabe Abubakar and his wife Amina were abducted in north-west Nigeria at the end of last month.

items.title: Australia to probe assault claims by Gaza flotilla activists against Israeli forces
items.description: Australian activists claim they were kidnapped, raped and tortured after being detained in May.
